title: Modern-Vintage Living in the Heart of Nashville
description:
This Modern-Vintage styled home is the perfect place to return to after an action packed day of exploring Nashville. A 1 bedroom, 1 bath home  conveniently located, where you'll enjoy easy access to popular destinations. This home Is well-equipped with everything you need for a hassle free retreat including a kitchenette, washer/dryer, comfy furnishings and free WIFI. This peaceful and unique place has comfort, style and ambiance for a relaxing stay!

The space
This a 400 sq ft, fully furnished, 1Bed/Bath apartment equipped with it's own washer/dryer, kitchenette, small dining area, 42" TV and fridge.

This is apt shares a wall with the other side of the home.

Guest access
This is one side of a duplex.

Other things to note
Your entrance is on the side of the house through the wooden fence. You can park in front of the wooden fence or through it.
